summary_en: 284,297,500 ordinary shares to be cancelled (10.9% of shares outstanding). Effective 2026-07-15. Represents all treasury shares acquired under board resolution of 2025-04-09. Post-cancellation issued shares: 2,320,258,349.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Seven & i Holdings resolved on 2026-07-15 to cancel 284,297,500 ordinary treasury shares pursuant to Company Law article 178. The cancelled shares represent 10.92% of issued shares outstanding (excluding treasury). This cancellation comprises all treasury shares acquired under the board resolution of 2026-04-09. Following the cancellation, total issued shares (excluding treasury) will be 2,320,258,349, and residual treasury holdings will be 5,486,242 shares (as of 2026-06-30, excluding shares held by Mitsubishi UFJ Trust Bank in connection with executive compensation BIP trusts and stock-grant ESOP trusts).
